sandbachFocus: Sandbach United drew 3-3 in a seven-goal thriller away at Cheadle Heath Nomads. Kyle Foley put Sandbach ahead early before Dylan Woods and George Colville turned it around for the hosts either side of half-time. Kieran O'Connell levelled on 63 minutes and Foley completed his brace on 77, but Cheadle Heath snatched a deep equaliser through Jack Higginbottom in the 94th minute to share the points.
divisionWide: Bilston Town hit seven without reply against Widnes Town, with Jordan Crump and Harry Dixon both scoring twice. Allscott Heath were even more ruthless, winning 7-1 away at Wednesfield Community as Ben Davies claimed a hat-trick. Stafford Town beat Alsager Town 5-2, and Market Drayton Town won 2-1 away at New Mills, including a stoppage-time equaliser before an Armando Wood penalty won it. Dawley Town and Brereton Social played out a goalless draw.
